About LottosOnline

The website www.LottosOnline.com ("LottosOnline") is owned and operated by Marvicap Limited, registered in Cyprus with Company Registration Number HE 336864. To support the operation, improvement, and communication of our services, LottosOnline works with a small number of affiliated entities and service partners who assist with customer support, operational functions, and service‑related communications.

What information LottosOnline collects

On Account Creation

When you create an account with LottosOnline we will ask you to provide the following information: First name, Last name, Email Address, Contact Number, Home Country. Once you have created your account, you have the option of adding your Gender, your Date of Birth and/or your Mobile Number to your Account Details section. You can update your details here at any future time (after logging in).

On Purchase

When you make a credit card payment you will be asked to provide: Date of Birth, Billing Address (including country), Payment Card Details. Once you have made a credit card payment, your card authorisation is stored as an anonymised token to facilitate your future transactions. You can remove your stored cards at any time by visiting the Payment Methods section of your account (after logging in).

While using the site

Our servers may automatically collect information about your computer when you visit LottosOnline, including without limitation the type of browser software you use, the operating system you are running, the website that referred you, and your Internet Protocol (I.P) address.

How LottosOnline uses your information

The personal information you supply through LottosOnline is used to provide you with the products and services you have requested. We use your e‑mail address to send you email confirmations of actions you have taken on LottosOnline (transactional emails). These include but are not limited to: confirmation of account creation, order confirmations, and draw result notifications. We may also use the information you have provided to respond to your customer queries; to improve the services that we offer by tailoring them to your needs; or to fulfil legal obligations related to operating the service (such as restricting services to those aged under 18, or preventing payment processing in any territory where we are unable to do so).

Service‑related communications

We may use your e‑mail address to send you service reminders, for example when we offer a new lottery game or introduce a new payment method or site feature.

Promotional communications

Where you have opted in to receive promotional messages, these may be sent by LottosOnline or by affiliated entities that support our services. If you have opted in to receive them, we will send promotional messages alerting you to special offers or exclusive deals. The frequency of these messages will depend on the status of the various lottery jackpots on offer. You can review and control your opt‑in status at any time by visiting your Account Details section (after logging in).

Cross‑entity communications

To ensure a consistent customer experience and to support the operation and improvement of our services, your information may be used by affiliated entities that support LottosOnline’s operations for purposes such as customer relationship management, service‑related communications, customer engagement activities, operational support, and service optimisation. These affiliated entities act as independent data controllers and process your information only for purposes that are compatible with those described in this Privacy Policy.

Data Retention

All personal data we hold (with the exception of details automatically gathered by our servers) is available for review in your Account Details section, and you can choose to update it there at any time. Only the most recent information is retained, and only for as long as you remain a registered user of LottosOnline. If you choose to close your account or if your account is terminated for any other reason, we will retain only the minimum data required to meet our legal and regulatory requirements.

Sharing your information

We will not share, rent or sell your personal information to third parties except as laid out in this policy. If the company and/or its assets are sold, your personal details may be disclosed to the purchaser of the company and/or its assets. We supply our service providers with the minimum personal details necessary for operating our service. This includes securely passing the details necessary for processing payments to our payment gateway service providers; use of email address and first name in our transactional email service provider platform; and, where we have your permission to send reminders and/or promotions, use of your email address, name and home country in our promotional email service provider platform. We may also share your information with affiliated entities that support our operations, for purposes consistent with this Privacy Policy.

Use of Cookies

A cookie is a piece of information that is deposited on your computer's hard drive by your web browser when you use our computer server. The cookies enable us to recognise you and give us information about your previous visits. We also use cookies to learn which advertisements bring users to our website. Most browsers accept cookies automatically, but usually you can alter your settings to prevent automatic acceptance. If you choose not to accept cookies, this may disable some of the features of our website. Cookies do not contain personal data such as your name, address, telephone number or email address.

Security and Protection of Information and Users of LottosOnline

LottosOnline uses Symantec Secure Socket Layered (“SSL”) encryption security products to ensure information is submitted and stored securely. Our payment providers use extended validation methods and secure their payment process behind multiple firewalls.

External sites and social media sharing

Our website may link to or contain links to third‑party websites that we do not control or maintain. We are not responsible for the privacy practices employed by any third‑party website. We encourage you to note when you leave our website and to read the privacy statements of all third‑party websites before submitting any personal information. Our website may contain features that allow you to share content or promotions with your contacts. If you send someone else a communication from LottosOnline (such as sending website content to a friend) the personal information you provide (names, e‑mail addresses etc.) will be used only to facilitate the communication and is not retained or otherwise used for any other purpose.
